figures.caption: Compounds 2, 5 and 10 kill enterococci. Time–kill curves for E. faecium ATCC19434 (A) and E. faecalis ATCC29212 (B) treated with compound 2 (●), 5 (■) and 10 (♦) at concentrations corresponding to 4× MIC. Growth controls in untreated BHI broth for both strains are also displayed (□). Each time point represents the average of at least three biological replicates and the error bars represent the standard deviation.
figures.label: Figure 2

figures.caption: Compounds 2, 5 and 10 interfere with membrane integrity to a different degree. Membrane integrity was assayed (at MBC; Table S3) by using the fluorescent dye propidium iodide (PI) that only crosses compromised membranes. Each group displays the average of three measurements and the error bars display the standard deviation. ★★★ p < 0.001.
